title: Widget of control audio/video in web browser thumbnails shown in all instead of one
line: With task grouping off, only the window that is playing media shows the media controls and album art in its tooltip.
explanation: Tooltips decide which window gets the media controls by checking whether a window title contains the playing track (hasTrackInATitle), but that check only ran inside group tooltips. With grouping off each window has its own single tooltip, which never set hasTrackInATitle and fell back to index 0, so every window of the player's process showed the controls and, for non-browsers, the album art. The single tooltip now computes hasTrackInATitle over the task model's windows with the same PID, and the controls, volume row and album art use the title match when it is set.

commits.message:
applets/taskmanager: show media controls only on the playing window

With grouping off, every window of a player's app got the media controls
and album art in its tooltip, as the window title check only ran for
group tooltips. Single tooltips now look at the app's other windows too.

BUG: 455654
